description: Get the latest live financial news from major sources (Wall Street Journal, New York Times, Bloomberg, Financial Times, CNBC, Reuters, Yahoo Finance). Returns pinned headlines (top stories, at offset=0 only) and recent news cards. Each card includes source name, timestamp (ET), title, full article text, and relevant stock tickers. By default, cross-source duplicates of the same story are folded into one card and the other outlets covering it are listed under 'Also reported by' (pass clusterDedupe=false to get every outlet's card separately). Use the 'before' cursor from previous responses to paginate forward through older news.

aiSummary.description: Return a concise AI-written summary (~80 words) in place of each article's full body. Use it to scan many stories quickly or to save tokens; keep false (full text) when you need to quote or deeply analyze the complete article. Default: false.

before.description: Time cursor for forward pagination. Pass the 'time' value of the last item from a previous response. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ET'

clusterDedupe.description: When several outlets report the SAME story, fold them into ONE card and list the others under 'Also reported by' (cross-source corroboration) instead of returning near-duplicate cards. Keeps the feed concise. Default: true. Set false only when you need each outlet's separate wording/framing, or want to gauge how many outlets covered a story.

limit.description: Number of news items per page (1-20). Default: 15

liveOnly.description: Return only real-time live-coverage cards (breaking, fast-moving updates) and hide long-form analysis articles (Bloomberg Latest and the outlets' standalone articles). Use when the user wants the latest developments as they happen. Default: false (includes both live cards and articles).

marketOnly.description: Filter to market/finance-relevant stories only, dropping general politics, sports and lifestyle coverage. Use when the user wants pure market news. Default: false (all news).

offset.description: Pagination offset. 0 = first page with pinned news. Default: 0

sources.description: Comma-separated source filter. Valid values: wsj, nyt, bloomberg, ft, cnbc, reuters, yahoo. Omit for all sources.

name: get_live_news
